title: Autopsy and Will
author: Rosalind Sterling
blurb: Noor Galloway, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
